# Semyon Morgunov / Семён Моргунов

> Head of FinTech at Yandex Uzbekistan — launches and scales digital products in emerging markets with positive economics. 10 years in tech: works in Russia and Uzbekistan, consults companies in Kyrgyzstan. Since 2009 launched four of his own ventures (one sold to employees). 5,772 readers across social channels. Based in Tashkent, Uzbekistan. Advises startups and angel-invests in e-com, RetailTech, FinTech, and EdTech.

## About

- Name: Semyon Morgunov (Семён Моргунов)
- Positioning: launches and scales digital products in emerging markets — places where product, operations and unit economics have to be assembled in parallel, fitted to the local context. Brings products to positive economics, not just to launch.
- Current role: Head of FinTech @ Yandex Uzbekistan, Tashkent, Uzbekistan (since April 2026) — Yandex Split BNPL, FinTech for Yandex Pro, strategic fintech partnerships
- Past roles: Director of E-commerce @ Korzinka (2023–2026, led Korzinka Go from 1 to 9 cities, orders ×23, positive EBITDA); Head of Product @ Yandex Services / Yandex.Uslugi (2022–2023, GMV ×2.2, positive EBITDA); Head of Growth & Monetization @ Skyeng/Skysmart (2017–2022); Certified Sales Trainer @ Apple Russia (2018–2019, contractor)
- Geography: works in Russia and Uzbekistan, consults companies in Kyrgyzstan
- Skills: FinTech, P&L Management, Product Strategy, E-Commerce, Growth, Monetization, 0→1 Launches
- Industries: FinTech, e-com, RetailTech, EdTech
- Teaching: I-Corps instructor; one of five Apple-accredited sales trainers in Russia at the time
- Languages: Russian (primary), English

## Products

- [Fingerprint](https://fprint.morgunov.tech/) — web service that reveals your browser's digital fingerprint and gives actionable privacy recommendations; runs locally in the browser
- [FoundYou](https://foundyou.morgunov.tech/) — web tool that reveals photo metadata (geolocation, time, device) and removes sensitive info; blurs faces, plates, documents; processes photos locally
- [Telegram channel «Semyon raspravil plechi» / «Семён расправил плечи»](https://t.me/raschet7) — personal channel on technology, products, management, and career; 1,137 readers; new posts every 1–2 weeks
